ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity to low-intensity pixels; the visible ventral surface is predominantly composed of dark, low-intensity pixels with high-intensity pixels isolated to distal tip anomalies.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a narrow vertex angle and a significant vertical depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with sharp pixel-amplitude peaks across the entire trailing edge boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature across the outer margins tapering into irregular, heavily textured distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, brownish-white pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of barnacles on the distal margins, resulting in a highly irregular and jagged tip morphology.
